title: Nightly backup job fails: 'You are required to change your password'
description_md:
The nightly backup sync runs as the `backupsvc` service account via `su - backupsvc`. It's been failing every night with `You are required to change your password immediately (administrator enforced).`, followed by an authentication error, since it has no interactive terminal to actually change anything. A box-wide password-aging policy rollout swept up this service account along with real human accounts. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out exactly what's forcing the change, and get `backupsvc` usable again.

You're done when `su - backupsvc -c 'echo ok'` runs successfully.
